files_summary.nps.json: US National Park Service DB: 46 real national parks keyed by 4-letter parkCode, each with fullName, states, description, and activities list; plus per-park alerts (closures/cautions/warnings), visitor centers with operating hours, campgrounds with amenities, and 2026 events.
files_summary.README.md: Schema, lifecycles and business rules of this benchmark's datastore.

tool_schemas.name: national-parks_findParks
tool_schemas.description: Searches our parks directory and returns a paged list of national parks that match your filters (stateCode, activities, and/or free‑text q). We refuse requests that include parameters outside this schema, or a limit greater than 50, because we only support the documented filters and page sizes. We also refuse requests with invalid filter values (for example, malformed stateCode lists or empty-only search terms) because they can’t be applied reliably.

stateCode.description: Filter parks by state code (e.g., "CA" for California, "NY" for New York). Multiple states can be comma-separated (e.g., "CA,OR,WA")

q.description: Search term to filter parks by name or description

limit.description: Maximum number of parks to return (default: 10, max: 50)

start.description: Start position for results (useful for pagination)

tool_schemas.name: national-parks_getParkDetails
tool_schemas.description: Returns the full details we have for a single park identified by parkCode. We refuse requests missing parkCode, or that include any other parameters, because parkCode is required and this call only supports that lookup. We also refuse requests where parkCode doesn’t match a known park, because there’s no park record to return.

parkCode.description: The park code of the national park (e.g., "yose" for Yosemite, "grca" for Grand Canyon)

tool_schemas.name: national-parks_getAlerts
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paged list of active alerts (closures, hazards, and advisories) optionally filtered by parkCode and/or free‑text q. We refuse requests that include unsupported parameters or a limit greater than 50, because only the documented filters and page sizes are accepted. We also refuse requests with invalid parkCode values (including unknown park codes in the list) because we can’t associate the alert query to a park.

parkCode.description: Filter alerts by park code (e.g., "yose" for Yosemite). Multiple parks can be comma-separated (e.g., "yose,grca").

limit.description: Maximum number of alerts to return (default: 10, max: 50)

start.description: Start position for results (useful for pagination)

q.description: Search term to filter alerts by title or description

tool_schemas.name: national-parks_getVisitorCenters
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paged list of visitor centers, including the operating hours and descriptive details we have, optionally filtered by parkCode and/or free‑text q. We refuse requests that include unsupported parameters or a limit greater than 50, because we only accept the documented filters and page sizes. We also refuse requests with invalid parkCode values (including unknown park codes in the list) because we can’t scope the visitor center search to a park.

parkCode.description: Filter visitor centers by park code (e.g., "yose" for Yosemite). Multiple parks can be comma-separated (e.g., "yose,grca").

limit.description: Maximum number of visitor centers to return (default: 10, max: 50)

start.description: Start position for results (useful for pagination)

q.description: Search term to filter visitor centers by name or description

tool_schemas.name: national-parks_getCampgrounds
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paged list of campgrounds and the amenities/details we have for them, optionally filtered by parkCode and/or free‑text q. We refuse requests that include unsupported parameters or a limit greater than 50, because we only accept the documented filters and page sizes. We also refuse requests with invalid parkCode values (including unknown park codes in the list) because we can’t scope the campground search to a park.

parkCode.description: Filter campgrounds by park code (e.g., "yose" for Yosemite). Multiple parks can be comma-separated (e.g., "yose,grca").

limit.description: Maximum number of campgrounds to return (default: 10, max: 50)

start.description: Start position for results (useful for pagination)

q.description: Search term to filter campgrounds by name or description

tool_schemas.name: national-parks_getEvents
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paged list of upcoming park events, optionally filtered by parkCode, a date range (dateStart/dateEnd), and/or free‑text q. We refuse requests that include unsupported parameters or a limit greater than 50, and we refuse date filters that aren’t in YYYY-MM-DD format or that form an invalid range (for example, dateEnd before dateStart) because we can’t apply the time window. We also refuse requests with invalid parkCode values (including unknown park codes in the list) because we can’t associate events to the requested park(s).

parkCode.description: Filter events by park code (e.g., "yose" for Yosemite). Multiple parks can be comma-separated (e.g., "yose,grca").

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return (default: 10, max: 50)

start.description: Start position for results (useful for pagination)

dateStart.description: Start date for filtering events (format: YYYY-MM-DD)

dateEnd.description: End date for filtering events (format: YYYY-MM-DD)

q.description: Search term to filter events by title or description

metadata.name: Trailhead Park Explorer API
metadata.description: Provides searchable access to U.S. national park information, including park details, alerts, visitor centers, campgrounds, and events for visitor-facing applications.
